products.name: Apex Pro TKL Gen 3
products.description:
WORLD'S FASTEST KEYBOARD — Push the boundaries with cutting-edge OmniPoint 3.0 Adjustable HyperMagnetic switches and new features
OMNIPOINT 3.0 — More than just fast, our newly redesigned Hall Effect Switch have 20x faster actuation and 11x quicker response time, with 40 levels of adjustable actuation.
GG QUICKSET — Game-ready presets for your favorite settings; recommended actuation levels, Rapid Trigger, Protection Mode, Rapid Tap and more with just a few clicks
REDUCED LATENCY — Rapid Trigger and Rapid Tap register keypresses faster for more responsive game play and improved aim.
PROTECTION MODE — A SteelSeries exclusive, reduce the sensitivity of surrounding keys when the intended key is pressed, preventing accidental inputs
OLED SMART DISPLAY — Adjust settings on the fly without ever alt-tabbing out of your game and control media
ESPORTS-READY — TKL form factor. Full-size functionality. Premium aluminum top plate. Detachable USB-C.

products.name: Apex Pro Mini Gen 3
products.description:

products.name: Logitech G502 HERO
products.description:
Grâce à une mise à jour logicielle gratuite disponible sur G HUB, la souris Hero 25K bénéficie d'une amélioration remarquable : un suivi 1:1, plus de 400 ips et une sensibilité maximale de 100 à 25 600 dpi, sans lissage, filtrage ni accélération.

11 boutons personnalisables et mémoire intégrée : attribuez des commandes personnalisées aux boutons et enregistrez jusqu'à cinq profils prêts à l'emploi directement sur la souris.

Système de poids ajustable : disposez jusqu'à cinq poids amovibles de 3,6 grammes à l'intérieur de la souris pour un équilibre et un poids personnalisés.

Éclairage RVB programmable et technologie Lightsync : personnalisez l'éclairage parmi près de 16,8 millions de couleurs pour l'assortir aux couleurs de votre équipe, afficher votre propre style ou synchroniser les couleurs avec d'autres périphériques Logitech G.

Tension des boutons par interrupteur mécanique : un système de tension à ressort métallique et des charnières pivotantes sont intégrés aux boutons gauche et droit de la souris pour un clic net et précis, avec un retour haptique rapide.

products.name: Flydigi Direwolf 3 Wireless
products.description:
Force-Adjustable Lever Joystick
Equipped with a Joystick-Dedicated Chip, Achieve Linear Control Curve, 12-bit Sampling, <1% Return to Center. With adjustable ultra-light resistance and precise centering, ranging from 40-100gf without damping adjustment, the Flydigi Direwolf 3 Gaming Controller ensures a gaming experience tailored to the user's unique style.

Multi-Platform PC Gaming Controller
Supported platforms: PC/NS/TV/Android/Laptop/xbox steam/Switch
Connection modes: wired/bluetooth/2.4G wireless Dongle.

1000Hz Polling Rate With 800mAh Battery
The wireless mode of the Flydigi Direwolf 3 Gaming Controller supports a 1000Hz polling rate, ensuring minimal input lag for a seamless gaming experience. Furthermore, the controller is equipped with a powerful 800mAh battery, allowing for extended gaming sessions without the hassle of frequent recharging.

products.name: LUMINKEY Magger 68 HE
products.description:
68-Key Exceptional Customization
The Luminkey Magger 68 HE mechanical keyboard innovative split top and bottom case structure, with its 68-key compact ANSI layout, anchored by screws, provides unparalleled stability, minimizing vibrations and extending the keyboard's lifespan. The high-quality aluminum positioning plate not only strengthens the design but also refines each keystroke's sound and feel, ensuring precision and stability in every press.

Enhanced Comfort with Ultra-Low Profile Design
The Magger 68 HE keyboard's ultra-low front height of 16.5mm is designed with ergonomics in mind, reducing wrist strain and making it ideal for extended use. This low-profile design, combined with magnetic switch technology, provides a light and fluid typing experience, reducing fatigue during high-frequency tasks. This attention to ergonomic details allows for a more natural wrist position, ensuring comfort over prolonged periods and enhancing productivity.
